Multitap on port 1 (players 3 and 4)
settings.help: Plugs a multitap into the first controller port, so players 3 and 4 can join. Only games that support one use it, and a few misbehave with it plugged in: turn it on for those games that want it.

settings.label: Multitap on port 2
settings.help: Plugs a multitap into the second controller port, for games that take more players there.
